featured_reviews.review_text: Dadar Shivaji Park has many ice cream parlours, but Nuvola sells fresh gelatos with delicious and unique flavours. The best part is that these gelatos are 100% vegetarian. I personally love their Burnt Butter Almond scoop and Dubai Chocolate.

featured_reviews.name: Saahil Ledwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Nuvola and tried out a few of their delightful desserts – Dubai Chocolate Lotus Biscoff, Dark Chocolate & Salted Caramel, and the Wild Berry Cheesecake. Each dessert had its own character, making the overall experience quite enjoyable.

The Dubai Chocolate Lotus Biscoff stood out with its rich chocolate base layered with the crunch and caramelized flavor of Lotus Biscoff. It was indulgent and had just the right mix of sweetness and texture, perfect for anyone who enjoys a decadent chocolate dessert.

The Dark Chocolate & Salted Caramel was another highlight. The slightly bitter notes of dark chocolate paired wonderfully with the smooth salted caramel, creating a balanced sweet-savory combination. It’s a dessert that satisfies without being too heavy.

The Wild Berry Cheesecake was the star of the evening – creamy, smooth, and bursting with fruity freshness. The tangy berries beautifully cut through the richness of the cheesecake, making it refreshing and absolutely a must-try.

Nuvola has a modern, welcoming vibe that complements their dessert range well. The presentation was neat, the flavors were thoughtful, and everything tasted fresh. While a couple of items could have been slightly lighter in texture, overall it was a very satisfying experience.

I’d rate the visit a solid 4/5. If you’re looking for a mix of indulgent chocolate desserts and refreshing cheesecake, Nuvola is definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Prasad Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I heard about this outlet of apsara ice cream from my friend soo I personally wanted to try the ice creams here as the first impression made by my friend in my mind was "the ice creams there taste yummy".
So I finally visited this place. Talking about the location is quite good near from western express Highway. Soo if you crave for ice cream at this location here you gooo!
The outlet has newof flavours and mark my words you will definitely get confused like what to order.
The ice creams as categorised as such.
1) Fruitylicious
2) Nuttylicious
3) Chocolicious
4) Sorbelicious
5) Kulfilitious
What I order was…
1) Pani Puri patakha :- As my friend Foodaastiic! 👅 suggested this sorbet to me, I was extremely curious to try it and the sorbet itself stand of expectations. A actual flavour of Pani Puri was into it and yes they GARNISHED the sorbet with crushed puri's which gave it a nice twist of crunchiness.
2) Asli Alphonso:- You can actually feel the actual taste of mango into it! Extremely delicious and creamy in texture which was actually good as you take a bit and place it into your mouth it use to get melt.
3) Pan pasand:- while eating this ice Cream you can actually feel like you are having a "mitha pan " in the form of ice cream . There were chunks of sauf which was quite amazing as you would get a feel of having actual ice cream.
4) Blueberry cheesecake:- A flavour of ICECREAM I tried for the first time and yes it was amazing. The creaminess of the ice cream was upto the mark and I loved it!
5) Fanky farrero :- It was good and had chunks of nuts into it which was amazing. The ice tasted good and actually felt like having Ferrero Rocher.
Talking about the overall experience was amazing a must visit outlet I must say as the ice cream here are just sooo fabulous ♥️.

The milkshakes themselves are absolutely outstanding. The texture is thick and creamy, exactly how a proper milkshake should be, and the flavors taste rich and authentic rather than artificial or overly sweet. Every sip feels indulgent without being overwhelming. The presentation is also impressive, making the whole experience feel premium and well thought out.
The staff deserves special appreciation. They were friendly, patient, and quick with service even though the place was busy. It’s clear that they care about quality and customer satisfaction.
Overall, this place sets a high standard for milkshake cafés. Great taste, great ambience, and great service. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a delicious treat.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered ice cream from Naturals via Zomato and tried two of their classic flavours: watermelon and tender coconut. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and definitely satisfied my dessert craving.

The delivery was smooth and the packaging was neat, which is always important for ice cream orders. Coming to the flavours, the watermelon scoop was refreshing and light, but I felt the flavour was slightly mild. It wasn’t bad at all, just a bit less punchy than I expected, especially if you’re someone who enjoys strong, fruity notes.

The tender coconut, on the other hand, was absolutely spot on. It had that rich, natural taste that Naturals is known for, with real coconut bits adding a nice texture. It felt fresh, creamy, and perfectly balanced in sweetness. Honestly, this flavour never disappoints and continues to be my favourite.

What I really like about Naturals is how their ice creams don’t feel overly artificial or heavy. Even with simple flavours, they manage to keep things authentic and enjoyable.

If you’re ordering, I’d definitely recommend going for the tender coconut without a second thought. The watermelon is still a decent choice if you prefer something subtle and cooling, but it may not stand out as much.

Overall, a good experience and I’ll definitely be ordering again soon.

featured_reviews.name: Amey Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried the mango milkshake and, unfortunately, it didn’t meet my expectations. The flavor lacked the richness and freshness one would typically associate with mango. In fact, I’ve had much tastier versions from simple roadside juice vendors. Definitely not worth the price.
If you are charging 250 for a milkshake which is not even close to 50 Rs milkshake please check your product quality....
